title: The template picker may use shorter role names than the Roles list
preconds: 1. You are on the Roles list and open the template picker.
steps:
1. Read the role names in the template picker.
  2. Close it.
  3. Read the role names in the Roles list.
  4. Compare them.
expected:
The Roles list uses the full names (Administrator, Parts Technician, Office User, Time Clock User).

The template picker may show shorter names (for example Admin, Parts Tech, Office, Time Clock) — confirm the exact picker labels live and flag any that differ from the list.
